_meta.indication: Acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults; not indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group single-attack study; patients randomized 1:1:1 to placebo, ubrogepant 50 mg, or 100 mg to treat a single qualifying migraine, conducted at 89 centers in the United States.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with a history of episodic migraine with or without aura; patients instructed to treat a migraine with moderate to severe headache pain intensity.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: pain freedom at 2 hours post-dose and most bothersome symptom (MBS) freedom at 2 hours post-dose, compared to placebo.
pivotal_trials.n: Randomized: placebo n=559, UBRELVY 50 mg n=556, 100 mg n=557.
pivotal_trials.result: Pain free at 2 hours: 50 mg 19.2%, 100 mg 21.2% vs placebo 11.8% (difference 7.4% and 9.4%; p=0.002 and <0.001). MBS free at 2 hours: 50 mg 38.6%, 100 mg 37.7% vs placebo 27.8% (difference 10.8% and 9.9%; p<0.001).

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled single-attack study; same design as MD-01 except doses studied were 25 mg and 50 mg.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with a history of episodic migraine with or without aura; patients instructed to treat a migraine with moderate to severe headache pain intensity.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: pain freedom at 2 hours post-dose and most bothersome symptom (MBS) freedom at 2 hours post-dose, compared to placebo.
pivotal_trials.n: Randomized: placebo n=563, UBRELVY 50 mg n=562.
pivotal_trials.result: Pain free at 2 hours: 50 mg 21.8% vs placebo 14.3% (difference 7.5%; p=0.007). MBS free at 2 hours: 50 mg 38.9% vs placebo 27.4% (difference 11.5%; p<0.001).

key_safety: The most common adverse reactions (at least 2% and greater than placebo) were nausea and somnolence. In Studies 1 and 2: nausea 2% (50 mg) and 4% (100 mg) vs 2% placebo; somnolence 2% (50 mg) and 3% (100 mg) vs 1% placebo; dry mouth <1% (50 mg) and 2% (100 mg) vs 1% placebo.
target_moa: Ubrogepant is a calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) receptor antagonist.
modality: Small molecule (oral CGRP receptor antagonist, 50 mg and 100 mg tablets).

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the application was not referred because the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled studies and the safety profile was deemed acceptable.

basis.text: The application was reviewed under Standard review classification.

summary.text: Ubrelvy (ubrogepant) was submitted as a 505(b) NDA received 12/26/2018 and reviewed under Standard classification with a PDUFA goal date of 12/26/2019. It was approved on the date of the approval letter (first cycle) without an advisory committee, based on two adequate and well-controlled Phase 3 trials; no accelerated approval or expedited-program designations were applied.

requirement.text: 3769-4: Conduct prospective pregnancy exposure registry cohort analyses in the U.S. comparing maternal, fetal, and infant outcomes of women with migraine exposed to Ubrelvy during pregnancy with two unexposed comparator populations.

citations.quote: 3769-4 Conduct prospective pregnancy exposure registry cohort analyses in the United States that compare the maternal, fetal, and infant outcomes of women with migraine exposed to Ubrelvy during pregnancy with two unexposed comparator populations: an internal comparator consisting of women with migraine who have not been exposed to Ubrelvy before or during pregnancy, and a comparator consisting of women without migraine. The registry will identify and record pregnancy complications, major and minor congenital malformations, spontaneous abortions, stillbirths, elective terminations, preterm births, small-for-gestational-age births, and any other adverse outcomes, including postnatal growth and development. Outcomes will be assessed throughout pregnancy. Infant outcomes, including effects on postnatal growth and development will be assessed through at least the first year of life.

citations.quote: 3769-5 Conduct a pregnancy outcomes study using a different study design than provided for in PMR 3769-4 (for example, a retrospective cohort study using claims or electronic medical record data with outcome validation or a case control study) to assess major congenital malformations, spontaneous abortions, stillbirths, preterm births, and small-for-gestational-age births in women exposed to Ubrelvy during pregnancy compared to an unexposed control population.
